reference_definition.const: For neutral doublet fragments A=(ligand)Ir and B=(ligand)Ir: E_int=E_AB-E_A(frozen)-E_B(frozen); E_def=sum[E_fragment(frozen)-E_fragment(relaxed)]; E_assoc=E_int+E_def, kcal/mol. Keep fragment charge/spin, basis/BSSE and relativistic definitions identical. This operational decomposition is not a unique partition of metal–metal versus ligand pi bonding.

validation_boundary: Format only. Raw outputs, controls, arithmetic and state identity must pass the scientific evaluator. A bounded failure is accepted for reporting, never as scientific completion.
